They will strategize regarding the Election Commission’s actions surrounding the electoral rolls. Opposition leaders have accused the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of irregularities and demanded his resignation. The bloc plans to continue its campaign against perceived threats to democratic institutions and has submitted a memorandum outlining its demands.

candidates.title: DRI busts Bangladesh-Kolkata-Hyderabad gold smuggling route, seizes Rs 5.84 crore haul
candidates.excerpt: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence arrested five people near Vijayawada after seizing gold and foreign currency worth Rs 5.84 crore. Officials allege the gold was smuggled from Bangladesh via Kolkata to Hyderabad. The agency also reported an earlier seizure near Visakhapatnam

candidates.title: New York court overturns foreclosure sale order in $400,000 mortgage row
candidates.excerpt: A recent ruling by an appeals court has overturned a foreclosure decision related to a property in Babylon, New York. The court determined that Bank of America did not give the borrower adequate notice prior to starting foreclosure procedures and failed to show that it had the necessary standing in the case. Consequently, the court rejected the bank's request for a summary judgment against the estate of Alice McNamara.

candidates.title: Allahabad HC tells all UP govt school teachers to get appointment letter, educational documents verified. Here's why
candidates.excerpt: A bench of Justice Vinod Diwakar directed teachers of Classes 1 to 8 to furnish legible copies of their appointment letters and educational documents to the Basic Shiksha Adhikari (BSA) concerned within a week of receipt of the notification issued from the office of the BSA.
